summary.name: Microsoft Edge
summary.one_liner: Microsoft Edge is a Chromium-based web browser from Microsoft, presented on this page as a Mac-native browser with built-in AI features.
use_cases: browse the web on a Mac
try a Chromium-based browser on macOS
use built-in AI features while browsing
find a free alternative browser for Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page is Microsoft's product overview for Edge, a web browser it describes as built for Mac and feeling native on macOS. It highlights AI innovations built into the browser and a section on doing more with Edge. The page text gives few concrete feature details beyond these headings. The listing on awesome-mac describes Edge as based on Chromium and categorizes it as freeware.
caveats: Feature availability and functionality may vary by device type, market, and browser version
Page content may have been translated using AI
